tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README introduces oxiguitar-coreaudio as the Core Audio output plugin for OxiGuitar, a guitar tablature and score viewer. It explains that the plugin plays OxiGuitar's sound through macOS's Core Audio system, producing a single universal .oxp file. The README also covers installation, build steps, and the GPL-3.0-or-later license.

tour.title: Plugin Manifest
tour.description: The manifest.json declares the plugin's identity: interface version 1.3, ID oxiguitar.audio-coreaudio, macOS-only conditions, and a single audio-device service (coreaudio) with priority 10. This file is the contract between the plugin and the OxiGuitar host.

tour.title: Build Configuration
tour.description: Cargo.toml defines the package oxiguitar-audio-coreaudio-plugin v0.1.0 with Rust edition 2024 and MSRV 1.99. Dependencies include the OxiGuitar plugin SDK (v0.11.0 via git tag), oxiguitar-audio-cpal for shared audio code, and cpal 0.18 for Core Audio. The release profile uses thin LTO and symbol stripping for small binaries.

tour.title: Core Plugin Implementation
tour.description: src/lib.rs is the heart of the plugin. The Audio struct implements OxiGuitar's Plugin trait (start, service) and Service trait (probe, call). On macOS it creates a CpalDevice wrapping cpal's Core Audio host; on other platforms the methods return Unavailable or Unsupported, making this a cross-platform build with macOS-only runtime.

tour.title: Build Script
tour.description: build-oxp.sh compiles the crate as a cdylib with the oxp feature flag, producing the distributable audio-coreaudio.oxp plugin file. This is the command shown in the README for building the plugin.

tour.title: Contract Testing
tour.description: tests/contract.rs builds the .oxp file and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host, asserting that the plugin meets the interface specification. This is gated behind #[cfg(target_os = "macos")] since the plugin only runs on macOS.

tour.title: CI Pipeline
tour.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs formatting checks, Clippy linting on the MSRV, documentation builds, tests on six platforms (Linux x86_64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86_64, Windows ARM64, macOS), cargo-deny licence/advisory checks, and DCO sign-off validation on pull requests. A ci-success gate ensures all jobs pass before merging.

tour.title: Release & Publishing
tour.description: The release workflow builds the .oxp on each system for PRs/develop/main (test builds) and creates draft releases from v* tags containing zip, .deb, .rpm, Windows installer, macOS .pkg, and SHA256SUMS. The publish workflow then sends these to package repositories and winget when a release is published.

tour.title: Development Workflow
tour.description: CONTRIBUTING.md covers the branch-and-pull-request workflow and DCO sign-off requirements. The DCO check script verifies commit sign-offs, and dependabot automates dependency updates. The pull request template guides contributors on describing changes and testing instructions.
